description: This file contains CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing test cases in a database, including functions to get, create, bulk create, and delete test cases.

methods.name: get_testcase
methods.description: Retrieve a test case by its ID from the database.

methods.name: get_testcase_by_uid
methods.description: Retrieve a test case by its UUID.

methods.name: get_testcase_by_name
methods.description: Retrieve a test case by name within a specific test file.

methods.name: get_testcases_by_file
methods.description: Retrieve all test cases associated with a specific test file.

methods.name: create_testcase
methods.description: Create a new test case in the database.

methods.name: create_testcases_bulk
methods.description: Create multiple test cases in bulk for a specific test file.

methods.name: delete_testcase
methods.description: Delete a test case by its ID.
